item.title: ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Ryan Bishop (Pettisville)
item.description: The male Athlete of the Week is Pettisville basketball player Ryan Bishop. In a dominating win over North Central on December 18, Bishop poured in 25 points, 10 in the first quarter, and grabbed eight rebounds on the night. The post ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Ryan Bishop (Pettisville) appeared first on The Village Reporter.

item.title: ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Addison Schang (Fayette)
item.description: The female Athlete of the Week is Fayette basketball player Addison Schang. The Eagle senior had 24 points in a December 8 win over Hudson, MI and then dropped another 24 points in a league opening win over Hilltop on December 19. The post ATHLETE OF THE WEEK: Addison Schang (Fayette) appeared first on The Village Reporter.
